 Urgent Park Outside Recall Issued For Nearly 721K BMW Vehicles 
 Posted by: KHTS News Release 
 in Press Releases , Santa Clarita Latest News 
 November 15, 2026 - 12:45 pm 
 0 
 106 Views 
 BMW of North America has issued a park-outside recall for 720,796 vehicles due to a risk of fire while parked and turned off.  
 An improperly sealed electrical connector on the water pump may be exposed to water and short-circuit, increasing the risk of a fire. 
 To date, BMW is aware of approximately 10 incidents in the United States that relate, or may relate to this issue, but is not aware of any crashes or injuries. These incidents occurred in vehicles that had been repaired under the previous recall. 
 A remedy for this new recall is currently in development and will be free at a BMW dealership when available. 
 The following models should be parked outside until remedied: 
 2012-2016 BMW 3 Series 
 2012-2016 BMW 5 Series  
 2012–2015 BMW X1  
 2012-2016 BMW Z4  
 2013-2017 BMW X3  
 2014-2016 BMW 2 Series Coupe  
 2014–2016 BMW 3 Series Sport Wagon  
 2014-2016 BMW 328xi Gran Turismo  
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series convertible  
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series coupe  
 2015-2016 BMW 2 Series convertible  
 2015-2016 BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe  
 2015-2018 BMW X4  
 2016-2018 BMW X5 xDrive40e 
 These vehicles were previously recalled in 2024 for a water pump issue and must be repaired again. If you have one of these vehicles, you should park your vehicle outside and away from buildings and other vehicles until the vehicle is repaired.
 Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning Dec. 25, 2026. Affected vehicle identification numbers and license plate numbers will be searchable on NHTSA.gov/Recalls beginning Dec. 25, 2026. 
 Owners may contact BMW’s recall hotline at 800-525-7417 or NHTSA’s Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236. NHTSA also encourages everyone to download its SaferCar app to stay informed on current recalls. 
 Ed. Note: The above information was provided to KHTS Radio by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
